description: Routes barrées en Mayenne is a dataset listed in data.lamayenne.fr open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Conseil Départemental de la Mayenne. Tronçons de routes départementales barrées ou restreintes lors de chantiers - Département de La Mayenne. Chantiers en cours ou à venir. Les itinéraires de déviations pour les routes barrées sont dans la couche "Itinéraires de déviation". Coverage: Mayenne. The portal files it under Mobilité. Its keywords are inforoute, cd53, travaux, alternat, routes départementales, route barree. The portal shows 31 records. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2026-06-08 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-lamayenne-fr-portal.
